text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winning positions, especially Stock D, to lock in gains; I should avoid letting the comfort of a realized profit alone determine when to sell.","My account value fell in the last two periods despite selling at gains, reminding me that individual trade profits do not guarantee good overall portfolio performance.","Past price changes do not predict future returns, so I should base future buy, sell, and hold decisions on risk and diversification rather than recent price history or my cost basis."]}
